title: PeopleSoft Studio's new-control templates replays App Designer's captured saves: every replay test passes
statement: src/test/pageControlTemplates.test.ts rebuilds App Designer's captured saves (HRDMO, PeopleTools 8.62.09) through Studio's new-control templates and requires App Designer's rows and counters; every top-level test passed in the recorded run. Evidence about Studio, not PeopleSoft (rule 3); it says nothing about releases not captured. docs/PAGE_SAVE.md lists the cases.

observations.observation: Run of src/test/pageControlTemplates.test.ts (node:test, TAP): 37 top-level tests, all passed.
